name: Standard Bank Group Limited
source: Yahoo Finance | CRON r16 (2026-10-12): H1 2026 column from the Standard Bank Group 1H26 results, condensed consolidated income statement in the analysis of interim financial results for the six months ended 30 June 2026. Printed group figures, ZAR million scaled to absolute ZAR: Total net income 98,981; Operating expenses 50,348; Net income before non-trading and capital related items 41,500; Non-trading and capital related items 132; Share of post-tax profit from associates and joint ventures 1,258; Profit before indirect taxation 42,890; Indirect taxation 2,237; Profit before direct taxation 40,653; Direct taxation 10,540; Profit for the period 30,113; Attributable to ordinary shareholders 26,193; basic earnings per ordinary share 1,615.6 cents. Operating expenses and direct taxation are stored positive to match the FY2025 basis of this file. Net Profit holds the profit attributable to ordinary shareholders (the printed 26,193 line), which is how the FY2025 column is stored, so profit before tax less direct taxation equals the printed profit for the period 30,113 and Net Profit is the attributable figure beneath it. A bank income statement carries no cost of sales, gross profit, operating profit (EBIT) or net finance costs line.
